moon_smirk.prompt: A single full moon seen straight on, a perfect circle centred in the frame with a small margin of plain flat pure black all round it, a pale cream-white cratered surface with soft grey-blue shadows, a face in the moon: two narrow slanted half-lidded eyes and a thin sly crooked smirk, the mouth lopsided and curling higher on one side, a few small uneven pointed teeth showing, sinister and amused. Nothing else in the picture, plain black background, no stars, no clouds, no text.
